prompt: I would rather (to check) the bus times before we meet.
explanation_ru: После would rather, когда подлежащее одно и то же, идёт инфинитив без частицы to: would rather check.

prompt: You keep forgetting; it's time you (to take) your medicine.
explanation_ru: После it's time нужен Past Simple со значением настоящего: it's time you took.

prompt: Bo talks to her little robot as if it (to understand) every word she says.
explanation_ru: As if о нереальной ситуации требует прошедшего времени: as if it understood (на самом деле робот не понимает).

prompt: I'd rather you (to cancel) your card straight away, before someone else uses it.
explanation_ru: При разных подлежащих после would rather идёт Past Simple: would rather you cancelled.

prompt: The new runner jogs round the track as if she (not / to be) tired at all.
explanation_ru: As if о нереальной ситуации ставит глагол в прошедшее время; после she допустимы и weren't, и wasn't.

prompt: Milos watches the new waiter carry the heavy tray of hot dishes across the busy curry house as though it (to weigh) nothing.
explanation_ru: As though с прошедшим временем показывает нереальное сравнение: на деле поднос тяжёлый, поэтому weighed.

prompt: Your neighbour keeps warning you about the frost, and it's high time you (to bring) the potted plants inside.
explanation_ru: It's high time требует Past Simple со значением настоящего или будущего: it's high time you brought.

prompt: For my sister's birthday I would rather ___ the gift myself.
explanation_ru: После would rather с одним и тем же подлежащим идёт инфинитив без to; to pick up — типичная ошибка.

prompt: My wrist keeps hurting, so it's time I ___ it checked by a doctor.
explanation_ru: После it's time ставится Past Simple, а не инфинитив: it's time I got (а не get).

prompt: The nervous traveller talks about flying as if she ___ everything about planes.
explanation_ru: As if о нереальном сравнении требует прошедшего времени: as if she knew (хотя она не знает всего).

prompt: Zoran writes that he cannot attend on Friday, and he would rather the firm ___ the interview to another day.
explanation_ru: При разных подлежащих после would rather идёт Past Simple: would rather the firm moved (а не to move).

prompt: The commuter phones the lost-property office. "It's time you (to report) the lost keys," the clerk says. He adds that he would rather the commuter (to pick) them up in person. The office is on the ground floor.
explanation_ru: После it's time нужен Past Simple (reported), а при разных подлежащих после would rather — тоже Past Simple (picked).

prompt: Dear team, my screen is cracked but I need the photos on it. Please do not delete anything while you work. I'd prefer you (not / to copy) the files anywhere else. You act as if I (not / to trust) you, and I am sorry about that.
explanation_ru: После I'd prefer you ставится not to + инфинитив, а после as if о нереальной ситуации — прошедшее время (didn't trust).

prompt: Nyoman would rather to speak to the teacher himself.
answer: Nyoman would rather speak to the teacher himself.
accepted_answers: Nyoman would rather speak to the teacher himself.
explanation_ru: После would rather с одним подлежащим не нужна частица to: would rather speak.

prompt: The teacher speaks to the shy girl as if they were old friends.
answer: The teacher speaks to the shy girl as if they were old friends.
accepted_answers: The teacher speaks to the shy girl as if they were old friends.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: as if + Past Simple (were) верно передаёт нереальное сравнение.

prompt: Beth looks at the long queue outside the station and turns to the stranger: "What if we will miss the last taxi?"
answer: Beth looks at the long queue outside the station and turns to the stranger: "What if we missed the last taxi?"
accepted_answers: Beth looks at the long queue outside the station and turns to the stranger: "What if we missed the last taxi?"
Beth looks at the long queue outside the station and turns to the stranger: "What if we miss the last taxi?"
explanation_ru: После what if о воображаемой ситуации используется Past Simple, а не will: what if we missed.

prompt: Please send me a new card. → Alice would prefer the office …
answer: Alice would prefer the office to send her a new card.
accepted_answers: Alice would prefer the office to send her a new card.
Alice'd prefer the office to send her a new card.
Alice would prefer it if the office sent her a new card.
explanation_ru: Would prefer + дополнение + to + инфинитив: Alice would prefer the office to send.

prompt: Please arrive a little early. → Rebecca would rather the whole team …
answer: Rebecca would rather the whole team arrived a little early.
accepted_answers: Rebecca would rather the whole team arrived a little early.
Rebecca'd rather the whole team arrived a little early.
Rebecca would rather the whole team came a little early.
explanation_ru: При разных подлежащих после would rather идёт Past Simple: would rather the team arrived.

prompt: A designer has a dentist appointment and needs to leave the office an hour early. He writes to his team lead.
options: I'd prefer you to let me leave an hour early.
I'd prefer that you to let me leave early.
I'd rather you to let me leave early.
I'd prefer you letting me leave early.
explanation_ru: Единственная верная форма — I'd prefer you to let (to + инфинитив); остальные содержат лишнее to или неверную форму.

prompt: Kaia cannot print her boarding pass, and the airport bus is leaving. She turns to the receptionist, imagining the worst.
options: What if we missed the flight?
What if we will miss the flight?
What if we to miss the flight?
What if we would miss the flight?
explanation_ru: Для воображаемой ситуации после what if нужен Past Simple (missed), а не will.

prompt: George talks as if he knew every single question in the interview.
options: George does not know every question.
George used to know every question.
George has never been to an interview.
explanation_ru: As if + knew показывает нереальную ситуацию: на самом деле Джордж знает не все вопросы.

prompt: It's high time the first-year student stopped wasting his evenings and made a proper study plan for his exams.
options: The first-year student has no study plan.
The first-year student has a study plan.
The first-year student finished his studies.
The first-year student never writes anything down.
explanation_ru: It's high time + made значит, что план ещё не составлен: реальная ситуация — у студента пока нет плана.

prompt: Put each sentence into the right group.

items.text: I would rather keep this desk a bit longer.
We would rather walk than wait for the bus.
She would rather not eat before the match.
I would rather you stayed a bit longer.
Would you rather I came with you?
My mum would rather I cleaned my room first.

explanation_ru: С одним и тем же подлежащим после would rather идёт инфинитив без to, с разными подлежащими — Past Simple.
